raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Reduce MXFP4 expert padding for ordinary Marlin on CUDA SM90 with BF16 activations and `VLLM_MARLIN_INPUT_DTYPE` unset. Use 64-channel intermediate alignment instead of 128 while retaining 256-channel hidden alignment and the existing guards for other backends/dtypes. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 at TP8 has logical N288, so the physical intermediate width becomes **320 instead of 384**. Existing loaders forward activation dtype; no C++ kernel change is required.

Applicability: this is a backend/architecture/dtype policy, with no model-name check. It applies to MXFP4 MoE weights using ordinary Marlin on SM90, BF16 activations, and no Marlin input-dtype override. Only intermediate widths whose 64- and 128-channel rounding differ can shrink. FP8 MoE, batched Marlin and the other guarded paths retain their existing policy. DeepSeek is the model-level performance example validated below; gains for other models have not been established.
Duplicate checks refreshed on October 29 found no separate open PR implementing this alignment policy. #50583 changes Kimi model/backend allocation ownership, #55232 changes compressed-tensors backend selection, and merged #57204 removes MegaMoE/DeepGEMM model-path padding. They address different paths. Related #49951 fixes ModelOpt NVFP4 quantization-group TP boundaries; this change preserves the checkpoint partition and only reduces Marlin's physical padding.

## Tests

The final H20 run passed **142/142 cases with no failures, errors or skips**: 126 allocation/input-mode cases, 12 numerical repack/MoE cases and four packed-weight/block-scale TP-loading cases. The real-constructor TP fixture explicitly requests the public `default_vllm_config` fixture. The equivalent repository selection is:

```bash
uv run --no-project --offline --python .venv/bin/python \
  .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  tests/kernels/quantization/test_marlin_tile_padding.py::test_mxfp4_marlin_intermediate_allocation \
  tests/kernels/quantization/test_marlin_tile_padding.py::test_mxfp4_marlin_moe_padded_round_trip \
  tests/kernels/moe/test_moe_weight_loading_padded.py::test_mxfp4_intermediate_padding_preserves_all_tp_shards
```

Acceptance executed those nodes in a disposable GW overlay container through `uv run --no-project --offline --no-sync --python /opt/glm53-image-gn/.venv/bin/python /opt/glm53-image-gn/.venv/bin/python -B /inputs/runner.py`. A separate old-API allocation assertion on unmodified GW reproduced **384 versus required 320**; that expected failure is reproduction evidence, not a passing unit test. Pinned Ruff 0.14 and applicable pre-commit hooks, including mypy and CI tethering, pass. The existing H100 FusedMoE CI job now selects the three nodes.

## Model and serving results

Actual TP8 worker metadata confirmed N384→N320 on eight ranks across 40 routed target layers. Their four expert-weight/scale parameters total **48,129,638,400→40,108,032,000 logical typed bytes per rank**, saving **7.470703125 GiB (16.6667%)**. This is not total VRAM, alias-deduplicated resident allocation, allocator peak or extra KV capacity.

Serving used H20×8 TP8, Marlin BF16/non-A8, DSpark5 adaptive verification, 64K context, seq32/batch8192/long-prefill threshold2048, fixed KV allocation, no prefix cache/LMCache, common CUDA graphs and NVLS=0. P changes only padding and retains baseline FlashMLA attention. The stock primary benchmark used 128 frozen rendered-text requests, each 8192 input/512 output tokens, concurrency 32:

```bash
uv run --no-project --offline --no-sync --python /opt/glm53-image-gn/.venv/bin/python \
  /opt/glm53-image-gn/.venv/bin/python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main bench serve \
  --backend openai --host 127.0.0.1 --port 28411 --endpoint /v1/completions \
  --model /model --tokenizer /model --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \
  --served-model-name DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 \
  --dataset-name custom --dataset-path /frozen/main_c32.jsonl \
  --custom-output-len 512 --skip-chat-template --no-oversample --disable-shuffle \
  --request-rate inf --num-warmups 0 --ready-check-timeout-sec 0 --ignore-eos \
  --temperature 0 --seed 20261028 --extra-body '{"seed":20261028}' \
  --trust-remote-code --save-result --save-detailed --disable-tqdm \
  --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl,e2el --metric-percentiles 50,95,99 \
  --num-prompts 128 --max-concurrency 32 \
  --result-dir /client-results/formal --result-filename main_c32.json
```

| Arm | Output tok/s | p95 TTFT s | p95 E2EL s |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| A0 | 768.937 | 12.4615 | 30.1514 |
| P0 | 838.999 | 11.5078 | 27.6967 |
| P1 | 843.274 | 11.4923 | 28.0228 |
| A1 | 774.226 | 12.4522 | 28.8733 |

Each P arm improves primary throughput by **8.37%–9.67% against both A baselines** and passes the prespecified main/32K-input p95 TTFT/E2EL guards. A/A throughput drift is 0.688%. The full A0/P0/S0/S1/P1/A1 sequence checked 1008 timed requests, 600 warmups and 144 quality requests. Every arm passed its 24-item semantic/strict-format gold set, including 8K/32K retrieval. P qualifies independently; the separate S attention candidate failed its gain/tail gates and was not combined with P.

Historical accuracy evidence, retained from the previous description: full GSM8K (1319 questions), with three fresh boots at baseline `bb5507741155` versus PR `238e1c21f478`, scored **1277/1280/1278 versus 1275/1280/1277**, differences **−2/0/−1**. Within-layout run variation was also reported; these results do not establish accuracy equivalence or prove all differences are noise. This historical evaluation was not rerun on current GW 5c and is not pooled into the new timing results. The new 24-item gold set does not replace it.

## Validation scope

- The sequence was interrupted after A0 by a harness port-check failure. A0's 167 frozen files were reverified and reused; the remaining five arms completed afterward. This is one interrupted balanced sequence, not independent-trial significance. Endpoint A/A checks cannot exclude all nonmonotonic drift; no blocks were trimmed or old performance runs pooled.
- Timings use the stock whole-call duration without profiler/diagnostic worker extensions. Small C1/C8 and long-request samples are guards, not a tail SLA. The gold set is limited regression coverage, not broad reasoning accuracy; the chat API does not expose output token IDs.
- GPU validation used GW vLLM `5c1eb11cb361d63668e813958b207edfc366827a`, Torch `2.14.0+cu130` and a guarded four-file Python P overlay. The tested policy source was based on `ab0e5ef7954190de2a74a6715d1382b08f5accc4`. All eight patch files apply cleanly to fixed upstream snapshot `7ab756940a89a7464ebd6ab26c7c6a1f3b7d08da`; the five changed method ASTs match both the tested candidate and verified GW-P payload, and the three added tests/benchmark retain their tested semantics. This establishes source compatibility, **not a native current-main build or E2E result**.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Compare MXFP4 MoE padding with identical logical weights and routes.
+
+Defaults reproduce DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash TP8 shapes. Weights and routing are
+synthetic; use a serving benchmark for model-level performance.
+"""
+
+import json
+import statistics
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from flashinfer.testing import bench_gpu_time_with_cupti
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.activation import ApplyMoEActivationConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.experts.marlin_moe import fused_marlin_moe
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.marlin_utils import (
+    marlin_make_workspace_new,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.marlin_utils_fp4 import (
+    prepare_moe_mxfp4_layer_for_marlin,
+)
+from vllm.scalar_type import scalar_types
+from vllm.utils.argparse_utils import FlexibleArgumentParser
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import round_up
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = FlexibleArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--hidden-size", type=int, default=5120)
+    parser.add_argument("--intermediate-size", type=int, default=288)
+    parser.add_argument("--num-experts", type=int, default=384)
+    parser.add_argument("--topk", type=int, default=6)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--tokens", type=int, nargs="+", default=[1, 32, 128, 512, 2048]
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--repeat-iters", type=int, default=30)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    e, k, n = args.num_experts, args.hidden_size, args.intermediate_size
+    assert k % 256 == 0 and n % 32 == 0
+    assert 0 < args.topk <= e
+    extents = [round_up(n, alignment) for alignment in (128, 64)]
+    if extents[0] == extents[1]:
+        raise ValueError("Choose an intermediate size with different padding extents")
+    weights, scales = [], []
+    for out_dim, in_dim in [(2 * n, k), (k, n)]:
+        weights.append(
+            torch.randint(
+                256, (e, out_dim, in_dim // 2), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda"
+            )
+        )
+        scales.append(
+            torch.randint(
+                119, 123, (e, out_dim, in_dim // 32), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda"
+            )
+        )
+    packed = {}
+    for padded in extents:
+
+        def pad_gate_up(tensor, padded=padded):
+            tensor = tensor.reshape(e, 2, n, -1)
+            return F.pad(tensor, (0, 0, 0, padded - n)).reshape(e, 2 * padded, -1)
+
+        packed[padded] = prepare_moe_mxfp4_layer_for_marlin(
+            SimpleNamespace(params_dtype=dtype),
+            pad_gate_up(weights[0]),
+            F.pad(weights[1], (0, (padded - n) // 2)),
+            pad_gate_up(scales[0]),
+            F.pad(scales[1], (0, (padded - n) // 32)),
+            None,
+            None,
+        )
+    del weights, scales
+
+    rows = []
+    for m in args.tokens:
+        x = torch.randn(m, k, device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+        ids = torch.rand(m, e, device="cuda").topk(args.topk, dim=-1).indices.int()
+        routing = torch.rand(m, args.topk, device="cuda")
+        routing /= routing.sum(-1, keepdim=True)
+        calls = {}
+        for padded in extents:
+            w13, w2, s13, s2, _, _ = packed[padded]
+            workspace = marlin_make_workspace_new(x.device, 4)
+            cache13 = torch.empty(
+                m * args.topk * max(2 * padded, k), device=x.device, dtype=dtype
+            )
+            cache2 = torch.empty(m * args.topk * padded, device=x.device, dtype=dtype)
+            out = torch.empty_like(x)
+
+            def run(
+                x=x,
+                routing=routing,
+                ids=ids,
+                w13=w13,
+                w2=w2,
+                s13=s13,
+                s2=s2,
+                workspace=workspace,
+                cache13=cache13,
+                cache2=cache2,
+                out=out,
+            ):
+                return fused_marlin_moe(
+                    x,
+                    w13,
+                    w2,
+                    None,
+                    None,
+                    s13,
+                    s2,
+                    routing,
+                    ids,
+                    quant_type_id=scalar_types.float4_e2m1f.id,
+                    activation_config=ApplyMoEActivationConfig(clamp_limit=10.0),
+                    workspace=workspace,
+                    intermediate_cache13=cache13,
+                    intermediate_cache2=cache2,
+                    output=out,
+                )
+
+            calls[padded] = run
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            calls[extents[0]](), calls[extents[1]](), atol=0.03, rtol=0.03
+        )
+        times = {padded: [] for padded in extents}
+        for order in (extents, extents[::-1]):
+            for padded in order:
+                times[padded].extend(
+                    bench_gpu_time_with_cupti(
+                        calls[padded],
+                        dry_run_iters=5,
+                        repeat_iters=args.repeat_iters,
+                        use_cuda_graph=True,
+                        cold_l2_cache=True,
+                    )
+                )
+        medians = {p: float(statistics.median(t)) for p, t in times.items()}
+        row = {
+            "tokens": m,
+            "median_ms": medians,
+            "speedup": medians[extents[0]] / medians[extents[1]],
+            # Two expert GEMMs: 2*M*topk*K*(2*N) + 2*M*topk*N*K.
+            "useful_tflops": {
+                p: 6 * m * args.topk * k * n / (ms * 1e9) for p, ms in medians.items()
+            },
+            "samples_ms": {p: list(map(float, t)) for p, t in times.items()},
+        }
+        rows.append(row)
+        print(
+            json.dumps(
+                {key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != "samples_ms"}
+            )
+        )
+    result = {
+        "gpu": torch.cuda.get_device_name(),
+        "capability": torch.cuda.get_device_capability(),
+        "torch": torch.__version__,
+        "dtype": str(dtype),
+        "config": {key: value for key, value in vars(args).items() if key != "output"},
+        "rows": rows,
+    }
+    if args.output:
+        args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tp_size,padded", [(4, 576), (8, 320)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("packing", [2, 32])
+def test_mxfp4_intermediate_padding_preserves_all_tp_shards(
+    tp_size, padded, packing, default_vllm_config
+):
+    """Packed weights and block scales cover the checkpoint exactly once."""
+    hidden, intermediate = 64, 2304
+    config = make_dummy_moe_config(hidden_dim=hidden, intermediate_size=intermediate)
+    config = replace(
+        config,
+        moe_parallel_config=replace(config.moe_parallel_config, tp_size=tp_size),
+        intermediate_size_per_partition_unpadded=None,
+        moe_backend="triton",
+        device="cpu",
+    )
+    with torch.device("cpu"):
+        experts = RoutedExperts(
+            layer_name="test_mxfp4_tp_padding",
+            params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            moe_config=config,
+            quant_config=None,
+            expert_map_manager=ExpertMapManager(
+                max_num_batched_tokens=config.max_num_tokens,
